How we build

Built to strict standards.

01
Market Thesis
Every strategy begins with a clear behavioural hypothesis about the Dow — directional bias, trend persistence, or time-of-day dynamics. No curve-fitting.
02
Rigorous Backtesting
Strategies are developed and tested in ProRealTime on IG Markets — with realistic spread, commission assumptions, and backtest periods of 8–16 years.
03
Performance Targets
A strategy must exceed 100% return, stay under 20% drawdown, and meet minimum Calmar and profit factor thresholds before it is considered for deployment.
04
Automated Execution
Confirmed strategies run fully automatically on IG Markets spread-bet accounts. Entries, exits, stops, and position sizing are all rule-based — zero manual input.
